request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and
make it green before finishing.

Reject creating an owner whose telephone number is already used by any other owner. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
Done. The full suite is green — 260 tests, 0 failures/errors.

## What I changed

The requirement is that creating an owner must be rejected with **409** if the telephone number is already used by *any* other owner. The codebase already had the 409 plumbing (`DuplicateOwnerException` → `HttpStatus.CONFLICT` in `ExceptionControllerAdvice`), but the duplicate check keyed off *last name + telephone*, so an owner with a new last name reusing an existing telephone slipped through.

**`ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — the duplicate detection in `saveOwner`:
- `hasIdenticalOwner` now scans `ownerRepository.findAll()` instead of only owners sharing the same last name.
- `isSameOwner` now matches on telephone alone, dropping the last-name condition.

**`DuplicateOwnerException.java`** — updated the Javadoc and message to reflect the telephone-only rule ("An owner with the same telephone number already exists").

This keeps the existing behavior intact (a byte-identical owner and a same-name/same-phone owner still conflict) while also catching the different-name/same-phone case, and still allows distinct telephones through.

Verified against the acceptance tests (`Cp01`/`Cp02`/`Cp03`), `OwnerRestControllerV1Tests`, and the JPA service tests, plus the full 260-test suite.
